description: Cancel one scheduled voice-agent call before it starts: Vapi deletes a scheduled call (place_voice_agent_call with scheduledAt), Telnyx a scheduled call (with agentId), and on Retell it ends a registered or ongoing call. ElevenLabs schedules only batches (cancel_voice_agent_batch). Without confirm:true nothing is cancelled. Free. Needs Vapi, Retell AI or ElevenLabs connected (Connectors, or connect_connector with the API key), or Telnyx for its AI Assistants.

provider.description: only when more than one voice platform is connected

name: cancel_voice_agent_call
title: Cancel a scheduled voice-agent call
